title: 第三十章 六域守序微光永存第二十九章 天启加冕星冕归位
slug: 星冕天启守护者觉醒录
lines: 澄澈万顷的天光铺满重建完整的天地山河，温柔和煦的清风穿过连绵葱郁的林海，拂过平整舒展的原野大地，携着万物新生的清甜气息，温柔熨帖着历经万古战火的世间每一寸角落。
绵延三载的暗影深渊浩劫，在暗樱女王神魂尽碎、暗影深渊本源彻底湮灭的那一刻，真正画上了盛大而圆满的**。
纵横全域的漆黑空间裂痕尽数愈合消散，震颤不休的大地彻底归于安稳，崩塌破碎的山峦江河稳步复原，曾经被暗影戾气层层浸染、荒芜破败的天地，此刻褪去所有阴霾晦暗，重归千万年前最纯粹、最明媚、最安宁的原始模样。
万里长空一碧如洗，无一丝流云遮挡，暖金色的日光毫无保留地倾泻而下，笼罩山川湖海、覆盖人间学园，温柔治愈着所有战火遗留的伤痕，滋养着破土新生的草木生灵。
空域中央，六位并肩伫立的少年少女周身，漫天流转的六色星辉缓缓敛入头顶的星辰王冠，融入一身神圣磅礴的传说圣衣之中。
天启加冕的圣辉缓缓落幕，天地本源的认可尽数落定，六大天启本源圆满归一、平衡共生，冰、草、水、土、幻、时六大域界秩序彻底挣脱暗影桎梏，修复所有破损、补齐所有缺憾、归位永恒稳态。
缠绕星界与人间万年的本源失衡、秩序崩塌、暗影肆虐之祸，自此彻底根除，永世不复。
天野凛星缓缓挺直挺拔的身姿，霜白耀金渐变的二段天启圣衣流光渐敛，衣身此前布满的灵力裂痕彻底被天启星辉修复殆尽，每一寸衣料都重归神圣规整、威仪万千。
他那头霜白晕染暖金的渐变长发不再被狂暴罡风掀动凌乱，温顺地垂落肩头，发尾萦绕的细碎圣光缓缓褪去，恢复了平日干净利落的模样。冰蓝色的眼眸褪去战时的凌厉威严，盛满尘埃落定的坦荡与温柔，眼底积压多日的疲惫与紧绷尽数消散，只剩全然的松弛与安宁。
方才全程承担核心灵力承压、串联全员羁绊共鸣的透支酸胀，在天地本源灵力的滋养修复下缓缓消解，枯竭的经脉重新充盈澄澈灵力，透支劳损的神魂彻底归于安稳平和。
他侧过头，目光温柔扫过身侧并肩而立的五位同伴，嗓音褪去战时的沉稳凌厉，染上少年独有的清和温润，字字轻柔、句句真切。
“所有暗影已然落幕，万古浩劫彻底终结。”
“往后山河无殇，人间无祸，世间再无暗影深渊肆虐，再无生死鏖战。”
历经无数次绝境逆袭、生死与共、羁绊相守，他们终于亲手扛下万古暗影，守护住了整片天地的安宁，守住了彼此不离不弃的羁绊。
藤咲若织静静伫立在他身侧，鎏红绛赤渐变的翠炎万华圣临圣衣光华内敛，草木与红莲双生本源平稳舒缓地流转周身，不再有战时极致澎湃的爆发之力，只剩温柔绵长、滋养身心的澄澈灵力。
头顶星辉铸就的红莲星辰王冠静静镶嵌在她鎏光流转的长卷发间，华贵雅致、神圣温柔，不张扬、不凌厉，却自带与生俱来的王族威仪与通透气度。
知晓所有隐忍过往、洞悉所有宿命重担的同伴静静相伴，身后是焕然一新、岁岁安然的万里山河，眼底积攒三年的孤寂、隐忍、负重与忐忑，在此刻尽数化作释然温柔的暖意。
方才坦诚所有身份、所有过往、所有苦衷的坦荡依旧萦绕心头，同伴们无条件的理解、包容、心疼与珍视，彻底抚平了她三年漂泊隐匿、孤身坚守的所有寒凉。
她微微弯起眉眼，温柔澄澈的眼眸里盛着漫天天光，漾开浅浅浅浅的笑意，温柔的嗓音轻缓传开，裹挟着如释重负的安稳。
“三年蛰伏，三年坚守，所有隐忍与奔赴，终得圆满归途。”
“我守住了想要守护的人间，护住了朝夕相伴的你们，亦未曾辜负与生俱来的王族宿命与族人期盼。”
三年前神域倾覆、家国破碎、至亲离散、族人流离，她孤身断后、坠落人间，收起所有荣光、藏起所有力量、压下所有悲恸，以普通学子的身份蛰伏学园，步步谨慎、日日坚守。
她熬过无人知晓的孤寂岁月，扛下无人承担的暗影凶险，藏起无人共情的家国伤痛，只为静待光明终局，只为守护人间烟火，只为留存最后的希望与羁绊。
而今风雨散尽、暗影归零、山河归序、羁绊长存，所有的坚持皆有归宿，所有的隐忍皆有回甘。
夜见幽弥立在藤咲若织身侧，冥紫鎏堇的冥幻星影轮回圣衣光影渐敛，虚实交错的幻影灵力彻底褪去战时的凛冽戾气，变得澄澈纯净、温柔安稳。
一头紫调渐变长卷发随风轻垂，清冷孤傲的眉眼彻底卸下了战时的戒备凌厉与过往的执念阴霾，眼底缠绕五年的伤痛、不甘、怨恨与孤寂，在此刻尽数烟消云散、彻底释怀。
曾经被爱人背叛、挚友欺凌、暗影操控的灰暗过往，曾被困傀儡宿命、深陷绝境黑暗、自我内耗沉沦的漫长岁月，都在一次次并肩守护、一次次温柔救赎、一次次真心相待中，被彻底治愈、彻底抚平、彻底终结。
她不再是孤身漂泊、无依无靠、被暗影裹挟、被执念捆绑的孤影，不再是被人算计、被人利用、被人践踏真心的傀儡棋子。
她是挣脱黑暗、救赎自我、守住本心、重获新生的幻之守护者，是被同伴珍视、被羁绊温暖、被世间温柔以待的少年少女。
清冷通透的目光扫过身旁一张张真挚温柔的眉眼，她唇角扬起一抹浅淡却真切的笑意，清冷的嗓音柔和释然，褪去了所有寒凉疏离。
“五年执念枷锁，三载暗影浮沉，今日尽数破除、尽数归零。”
“我与过往和解，与世界和解，与自己和解。从此前路无阴霾，余生皆光明，岁岁伴羁绊，步步皆坦途。”
过往所有的伤害与委屈、所有的挣扎与沉沦、所有的偏执与恨意，都已然随暗樱女王的覆灭、暗影深渊浩劫的终结，彻底化作过往序章。
往后她不必再孤身对抗暗影，不必再蜷缩自我封闭本心，不必再被过往伤痛困住脚步。前路有并肩同行的挚友，有岁岁安稳的人间，有永不消散的光明与羁绊。
御神苍瞬沉静伫立阵型后侧，霆苍鎏冰的时序霆光神域圣衣雷光敛息、纹路归静，纵横周身的时空灵力不再急速流转、制衡战局，只剩平稳舒缓、修复身心的澄澈本源之力。
曾经缠绕神魂、刻入心底的冰川神域覆灭的阴影，那些亲眼目睹家园崩塌、族人陨落、至亲离世的刻骨恐惧与绝望，那些常年封闭内心、抗拒力量、畏惧宿命的孤僻与怯懦，在无数次团队并肩、全员相守、温柔包容的羁绊中，彻底烟消云散。
她不再恐惧力量带来的失去，不再逃避与生俱来的宿命，不再封闭内心隔绝温暖。
她终于明白，力量从不是灾祸的根源，守护从来不是徒劳的牺牲。真正的力量，是用以守护所爱、捍卫光明、留存温暖；真正的宿命，是并肩坚守、彼此救赎、岁岁相守。
清冷沉静的眼眸褪去所有孤寒凉漠，添上几分温柔暖意，她望着满目新生的山河天地，平稳淡然的嗓音带着彻底释怀的笃定。
“冰川过往皆为序章，宿命枷锁尽数挣脱。”
“自此我接纳雷霆时序之力，扛起守护者宿命，敞开本心、融入羁绊，拥抱人间烟火、珍惜朝夕相伴，不再孤身负重、不再封闭自困。”
历经战火淬炼与羁绊治愈，那个孤僻冷漠、拒人千里、自我封闭的冰川少女已然落幕。
如今的御神苍瞬，是心怀温柔、眼底有光、勇于担当、懂得珍惜的时之守护者，是战队温暖相守、并肩同行的可靠家人。
content_en:
Vast expanse of clear sky covered the reconstructed world, mountains and rivers, and the gentle and gentle breeze passed through the continuous lush forest and blew over the flat and stretched wilderness. It carried the sweet breath of the rebirth of all things and gently touched every corner of the world that had gone through eternal wars.
The catastrophe of the Shadow Abyss that lasted for three years truly came to a grand and complete climax at the moment when Queen Dark Cherry's soul was shattered and the origin of the Shadow Abyss was completely annihilated.
The cracks in the dark space across the entire territory have all healed and dissipated, the trembling earth has completely returned to stability, and the collapsed and broken mountains and rivers have steadily recovered. The desolate and dilapidated world that was once suffocated by layers of shadows and vicious gases has now shed all the gloom and gloom, returning to the purest, brightest, and most peaceful original appearance tens of millions of years ago.
The sky for thousands of miles is as clear as a wash, not covered by a single drifting cloud. The warm golden sunlight pours down without reservation, covering the mountains, rivers, lakes and seas, and the human academy. It gently heals all the scars left by the war and nourishes the new vegetation and creatures.
In the center of the airspace, around six young girls standing side by side, the six-color starlight flowing all over the sky slowly merged into the star crown above their heads, blending into a sacred and majestic legendary holy garment.
The crowning glory of the Apocalypse slowly comes to an end, and the recognition of the origins of heaven and earth is all settled. The six origins of the Apocalypse are perfectly unified and coexisting in balance. The order of the six realms of ice, grass, water, earth, illusion, and time has completely broken away from the shackles of the shadow, repairing all damage, filling up all shortcomings, and returning to eternal stability.
The source of imbalance, the collapse of order, and the raging shadows that have plagued the star world and the human world for thousands of years have been completely eradicated and will never return.
Amano Rinxei slowly straightened his figure, and the two sections of the Apocalypse Holy Clothes gradually faded from frosty white to shining gold. The spiritual cracks that were previously covered in the clothes were completely repaired by the Apocalypse Starlight, and every inch of the clothes returned to sacred order and majesty.
His long, frosty white hair that was dyed warm and golden was no longer tossed and messed up by the violent wind. It fell down gently on his shoulders. The fine fragments of holy light lingering at the end of his hair slowly faded away, returning to his usual clean and tidy appearance. The icy blue eyes had lost their fierceness and majesty during the war, and were filled with magnanimity and gentleness that had settled down. The fatigue and tension accumulated in the eyes for many days had all dissipated, leaving only complete relaxation and tranquility.
The overdraft and acidity that had just been under pressure on the core spiritual power for the whole process and connected the resonance of all members slowly disappeared under the nourishment and repair of the original spiritual power of heaven and earth. The depleted meridians were refilled with clear spiritual power, and the soul that was overdrawn and strained completely returned to stability and peace.
He turned his head and glanced gently at the five companions standing side by side. His voice lost the calmness and sharpness during the war, and was tainted with the unique gentleness and gentleness of a young man. His words were soft and every sentence was true.
"All shadows have ended, and the eternal catastrophe has completely ended."
"From now on, there will be no peace in the mountains and rivers, no disaster in the world, no more shadowy abyss raging in the world, no more fierce battles of life and death."
After countless desperate counterattacks, sharing life and death, and staying together, they finally shouldered the shadow of eternity with their own hands, guarded the peace of the entire world, and maintained the bond that never leaves each other.
Fujisaki Wakaori stood quietly beside him, the radiance of the emerald flames of the Holy Cloth of Ten Thousand Flowers that gradually changed from gilded crimson to crimson was restrained, and the twin origins of vegetation and red lotus flowed around him smoothly and gently. There was no longer the extreme explosive power during the war, only the gentle and long-lasting clear spiritual power that nourished the body and mind.
The red lotus star crown made of stars above her head is quietly embedded in her long gilded curly hair. It is luxurious and elegant, sacred and gentle, not ostentatious, not sharp, but with inherent royal majesty and airiness.
Companions who know all the forbearance of the past and understand all the burdens of destiny are quietly accompanying each other. Behind them are thousands of miles of mountains and rivers that are renewed and safe every year. The loneliness, forbearance, burden and anxiety accumulated for three years in the eyes are all transformed into the gentle warmth of relief at this moment.
The magnanimity with which she had just confessed all her identity, all her past, and all her troubles still lingered in her heart. The unconditional understanding, tolerance, distress and cherishment of her companions completely healed all the coldness of her three years of wandering and hiding, and holding on alone.
She slightly arched her eyebrows, her gentle and clear eyes were full of light from the sky, she smiled lightly, and her gentle voice spread softly, carrying a sense of relief and stability.
"Three years of dormancy, three years of perseverance, all the patience and hard work, and finally a successful return."
"I protected the human world I wanted to protect, and protected you who accompany me day and night, and I never failed to live up to my birthright as a royal family and the expectations of my people."
Three years ago, the divine realm was overthrown, her family and country were shattered, her relatives were separated, and her clansmen were displaced. She was alone and fell into the world. She put away all her glory, hid all her strength, suppressed all her sorrow, and hid in the academy as an ordinary student. She took every step cautiously and persevered day by day.
She survived the lonely years that no one knew about, shouldered the shadow dangers that no one bore, hid the pain of her family and country that no one could empathize with, just to wait for the bright ending, just to protect the fireworks in the world, just to retain the last hope and bond.
Now the wind and rain have dissipated, the shadows have returned to zero, the mountains and rivers have returned to order, and the bonds will last forever. All persistence has its destination, and all forbearance has its reward.
Yami Yuya stood beside Fujisaki Wakaori, the light and shadow of the Purple Violet Phantom Star Shadow Samsara Saint Cloth gradually faded away, and the phantom spiritual power that intertwined the virtual and the real completely faded away from the harsh and violent atmosphere during the war, and became clear, pure, gentle and stable.
Her long purple-tone curly hair hangs gently in the wind, and her cold and aloof eyebrows have completely shed the wartime vigilance and the haze of past obsessions. The pain, unwillingness, resentment, and loneliness that have been lingering for five years in her eyes have all disappeared at this moment, and she is completely relieved.
The gloomy past of being betrayed by lovers, bullied by close friends, and manipulated by shadows, the long years of being trapped in puppet fate, deep in despair and darkness, and self-destruction, have all been completely healed, completely smoothed, and completely ended through side-by-side protection, gentle redemption, and sincere treatment.
She is no longer a lonely figure wandering alone, helpless, wrapped in shadows, and bound by obsession. She is no longer a puppet who is plotted, used, and trampled on her true heart.
She is the guardian of illusion who breaks away from the darkness, redeems herself, keeps her true heart, and regains her life. She is a young girl who is cherished by her companions, warmed by fetters, and treated tenderly by the world.
Her cold and transparent eyes swept over the sincere and gentle eyebrows next to her. A faint but genuine smile appeared on the corner of her lips. Her cold voice was soft and relieved, and all the coldness and alienation faded away.
"Five years of shackles of obsession, three years of shadows rising and falling, today they are all broken and all are restored to zero."
"I have reconciled with the past, with the world, and with myself. From now on, there will be no haze on the road, and the rest of my life will be bright. I will be bound by obstacles year after year, and everything will be smooth every step of the way."
All the past hurts and grievances, all the struggles and sinkings, all the paranoia and hatred, have completely turned into the prologue of the past with the destruction of Queen Dark Sakura and the end of the catastrophe of Shadow Abyss.
From now on, she no longer has to fight the shadows alone, no longer has to huddle up and close her heart, and no longer has to be trapped by the pain of the past. There are close friends walking side by side on the road ahead, a world that is stable year after year, and a light and bond that will never fade away.
Royal God Cang Shun stood quietly at the back of the formation. The thunder and lightning of the Ting Cang Glazed Temporal Ting Guang Divine Realm Saint Cloth calmed down, and the lines returned to silence. The time and space spiritual power across the body no longer circulated rapidly to check and balance the battle situation, only the clear source power that was smooth, soothing, and repairing the body and mind was left.
The shadow of the destruction of the Glacier God Realm that once haunted the soul and was engraved in the bottom of the heart, the deep-seated fear and despair of witnessing the collapse of the home, the demise of the tribe, and the death of loved ones, and the loneliness and cowardice that had closed the heart, resisted power, and feared fate all year round, had completely disappeared in the countless times of teamwork, full support, and gentle and tolerant bonds.
She no longer fears the loss of power, no longer escapes her innate destiny, and no longer closes her heart to isolate herself from warmth.
She finally understood that power was never the source of disaster, and protection was never a futile sacrifice. The real power is to protect the ones you love, defend the light, and retain the warmth; the real destiny is to stand side by side, save each other, and stay together year after year.
Her cold and calm eyes faded away from all the loneliness and indifference, adding a bit of tenderness and warmth. She looked at the mountains, rivers and world full of new life, and her steady and calm voice carried the determination of complete relief.
"The past of the glacier is the prologue, and all the shackles of fate are broken."
"Since then, I have accepted the power of the thunder sequence, shouldered the destiny of the guardian, opened my heart, integrated into the fetters, embraced the fireworks of the world, cherished the company day and night, and no longer bear the burden alone, no longer closed and trapped."
After being tempered by the flames of war and healed by bonds, the solitary, indifferent, self-isolated glacier girl has come to an end.
Today's Royal God Cang Shun is the guardian of time with a gentle heart, bright eyes, courage to take responsibility, and knows how to cherish. He is a reliable family member who stays with the team and walks side by side.
title_en: Chapter 30: The Lawful Glimmer of the Six Domains Will Eternal Chapter 29: The Coronation of the Apocalypse and the Return of the Star Crown
